LanguageData.RHA_G18_Recipient: Choose the personal challenge recipient or the colony challenge leader. The choice is fixed when accepted.
LanguageData.RHA_G18_Intro: Track one path at a time. Milestone rewards are once per save; replay to improve records. Hover for rules.
LanguageData.RHA_G18_Rules:
Foundation: obtain the required distinct sources and choose a base evolution.
Practice: personal paths require 3 casts of their path ability during trial combat; colony paths require 2 casts at a player home by any free colonist. Only casts after claiming the previous milestone count.
Certification: have at least 5 distinct sources and a base evolution at both trial start and the third wave clear. Start a new standard trial at tier 3 or higher, with challenge rules enabled and intensity at least 100%. Endless trials do not count. Personal paths require one path-ability cast while trial enemies remain in EACH wave. Colony paths require one additional cast BEFORE starting. The assigned participant must be alive, standing and on the trial map at start and completion.
Records show the highest tier and fastest time at that tier, including preparation and intermissions. Abandoning resets current-stage counts; claimed milestones and victory records remain.
LanguageData.RHA_G18_FoundationHint: Claim the first milestone once the build is ready. Repeated stacks count as one source.
LanguageData.RHA_G18_FinalHero: Start a tier 3+ standard trial (rules at 100%+). Cast the path ability in each wave; finish alive and standing.
LanguageData.RHA_G18_FinalColony: Cast the path ability once, then start a tier 3+ standard trial (rules at 100%+). The coordinator must finish alive and standing.
